input.question: Which person or organization did Eliana Amorim de Souza work for?

documents.text:
Title: The Academic Pursuits of Eliana Amorim de Souza: Unraveling the Ties to Federal University of Bahia

In the vibrant city of Salvador, Bahia, where the rhythms of Afro-Brazilian culture pulse through the streets, a renowned researcher was making waves in the academic community. Eliana Amorim de Souza, a distinguished scholar with an ORCID ID of 0000-0002-9653-3164, had built a reputation for herself as a meticulous and innovative thinker. But what was the foundation of her esteemed career? The answer lay in her affiliation with the prestigious Federal University of Bahia. As we delve into the life and work of Eliana Amorim de Souza, it becomes clear that her connection to the Federal University of Bahia was more than just a passing association. In fact, it was a symbiotic relationship that fueled her growth as a researcher and contributed significantly to the university's rich academic heritage. The first thread of evidence that weaves together Eliana's narrative with the Federal University of Bahia is her publication record. A cursory glance at her ORCID profile reveals a plethora of research papers, many of which were co-authored with colleagues from the university. One such paper, titled "Innovative Approaches to Sustainable Development in the Brazilian Northeast," was published in a reputable international journal and featured Eliana as the lead author. The paper's acknowledgments section explicitly thanks the Federal University of Bahia for providing the necessary resources and support for the research. Further investigation reveals that Eliana was not only a frequent collaborator with the university's faculty members but also a regular participant in academic events hosted by the institution. In 2018, she presented a keynote address at the Federal University of Bahia's annual research symposium, where she shared her insights on the intersection of technology and social justice. The symposium's program, available online, lists Eliana as an affiliated researcher with the university's Department of Social Sciences. Another crucial piece of evidence lies in Eliana's own words. In an interview with a prominent Brazilian academic journal, she spoke candidly about the role the Federal University of Bahia played in shaping her research agenda. "My time at the university was instrumental in helping me develop a nuanced understanding of the complex social dynamics at play in Bahia," she reflected. "The support and guidance I received from my colleagues and mentors were invaluable in shaping my research trajectory."
